chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea, then both copies of Water's Edge, all targeting Seapunk, for 21 total printed damage.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Thoma — Crimson Ooyoroi followed by All Streams Flow to the Sea, dealing 17 total printed damage while gaining 3 Block.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 3 Block from Thoma — Crimson Ooyoroi, so the telegraphed attack deals 3 more unblocked damage, in exchange for 4 more damage to Seapunk.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. A sufficiently larger attack intent would have made the 3 Block from Thoma — Crimson Ooyoroi more valuable and could have changed my choice to the Thoma line.
